sentences.text: The living room showed an elevated humidity, reaching 41.2 % between 03:00 and 06:00.
At the same time, the temperature dropped to 16.6 °C, which is below the expected 18.0 °C, starting at 04:20.
Because the humidity and temperature changed together, it is probably due to a common environmental factor, such as a draft or a change in the outside weather.
